A bundle written to make every finding kind fire at once, so the golden output has content to be
identical to. Google's four reference bundles are conformant and mostly print nothing, which is a
poor baseline for a change that must not alter output.

## Decision

* [Linked](decisions/linked.md) - reachable, so not an orphan.
* [Typeless](decisions/typeless.md) - the one conformance error here.
